title: 5 mistakes that ruin AI answers

sources.name: Prompting guidance: break tasks into steps, give context and examples

caption:
5 common prompting mistakes and the simple fix for each.
Most bad answers come from missing context, too many requests at once or skipping the review.
Save this fix list. Comment MISTAKES and I will send it.

slides.headline: Asking for everything at once
body: Fix: split the job into steps.

slides.headline: Giving no context
body: It cannot guess your audience or goal.
slides.prompt: I am writing for [audience]. My goal is [goal]. They already know [background].

slides.headline: Never showing an example
body: A sample of the style you want beats a description.
slides.prompt: Match the style and length of this example: [example]. Use my topic: [topic].

slides.headline: Trusting the first draft
body: Drafts can contain wrong facts or the wrong tone.
Fix: read it and ask for one change.

slides.headline: Pasting private information
body: Remove names, numbers and anything confidential first.

slides.headline: Draft, check, revise
body: Get a first version, review it, then ask for targeted edits.
slides.prompt: Revise the second paragraph to be shorter and more direct. Keep everything else the same.

slides.headline: Have it ask you questions
slides.prompt: Before you answer, ask me up to three questions about anything unclear.

slides.headline: Save this fix list
body: Comment MISTAKES and I will send it.
Share this with someone who is frustrated with AI answers.
